inputs.text: Local organizers in southern Alberta are currently gathering signatures for the Water Not Coal petition launched by Corb Lund last month. This effort is aimed at getting the Government of Alberta to pass legislation that prohibits all coal exploration. Grassroots efforts like this are crucial in the fight against the systemic power of industries that prioritize profits over people and the environment. These actions expose how our institutions have failed due to a history of favoring exploitation, which has led to threats against water and land that disproportionately affect the most vulnerable and increase inequality. We can only achieve real change by having ordinary people demand that the public good comes before development that only serves the interests of the powerful.
